description.value: Long Beach Lodge Resort is an award-winning luxury boutique hotel perched on the beachfront of Cox Bay in Tofino, recognized by Condé Nast Traveler and World Travel Awards as BC's leading boutique hotel. The property blends oceanfront lodge rooms and self-contained Rainforest Cottages with on-site surf lessons, a cedar sauna and hot pool, and a full-service spa. It is a full-amenity base camp for exploring the Pacific Rim coast, with e-bike rentals available through the Surf Club.

address.value: 1441 Pacific Rim Highway, Tofino, BC V0R 2Z0

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website provides rich content across multiple subpages. The FAQ confirms laundry facilities, on-site evening dining (Great Room, SandBar Bistro, Surf Club), and e-bike rentals through the Surf Club. Neither the FAQ, Stay, nor any other subpage mentions secure overnight bike storage or a staff bike-handling procedure, so both required criteria remain null. OSM toll-free phone and address match the website exactly.
concerns: Website lists a local phone number (250.725.2442) not present in OSM; the OSM toll-free (1.877.844.7873) is confirmed on the website as well. Consider adding the local number to the listing.
Eight complimentary EV chargers are confirmed on-site (FAQ), which may support e-bike charging, but this is not explicitly stated — worth clarifying during review outreach.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The resort is a high-profile, full-amenity accommodation in a premier BC cycling destination and offers e-bike rentals, laundry, and evening dining — all valuable to touring cyclists. However, neither secure overnight bike storage nor a staff bike procedure is mentioned anywhere on the website, and direct outreach is needed to confirm these required WWC criteria before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: E-bike rentals are available through the Surf Club per the FAQ. The resort holds a BC Green Business certification and a 2026 BC Water-Friendly Business award.

Laundry.detail: Contact page confirms: 'Fitness Room & Laundry Open daily 6 a.m.–11 p.m.'

Nearby evening food.detail: Three on-site food outlets serve evening meals: The Great Room (dinner 5–8:30 p.m.), SandBar Bistro, and the Surf Club (open daily for dine-in and takeout)
